articles.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
articles.snippet: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

articles.title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in 'Impossible' Game
articles.snippet: Google’s Willow quantum processor beat the classical ceiling in a four-qubit coordination game, revealing a promising hardware test rather than commercial quantum computing.

articles.title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
articles.snippet: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

articles.title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
articles.snippet: Levent Alpöge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic’s IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

articles.title: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
articles.snippet: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.
